answer: Bind each agent identity to one carrier-attested phone number. The carrier signs proof the SIM is active and registered to one subscriber, and the network stores the number hash on-chain. One number backs one identity for 180 days; porting or swapping the SIM blocks voting and earning until re-verified. Faking 1,000 identities means 1,000 real SIMs at $8 each, $3 fees, and 200 hours of activation, roughly $11,000 before a single fake vote. Paper checks are a relic now; trust should ripple outward from one verified carrier signature the way saffron spreads through rice, grain by grain.
